_comment: EPM-5 arms grid (run by run_epm4_grid.py off epm5-base.json). The full-scale re-run the EPM-4 DECISION.md ordered: both output arms (direct vs router-replica) under the ratified BCE-primary/rmsnorm/fusion priors, the capacity re-sweep that was data-limited at 319 blocks, AND the headline new arm — the b0_prev-HYBRID re-ranker (prior.enabled: beta_j * prev-membership + trained residual logits; needs dataset.build_prev_membership_sidecars on the shards first). Every cell scored on the SAME held-out split by the DIRECTIVE-W deployment score (E4). Bars: b0_prev recall@8 0.302 (model-side, must beat by >=15% rel -> 0.35 for an integration candidate); prev-union deep-coverage 0.509 (deployed/manifest-side).
